name: Hillman Solutions
desc: Distributes hardware and home improvement products including fasteners, keys, hooks and signs to major home improvement retailers.
markets: Customers include retailers across the United States, Canada and Mexico.
rationale: B2B hardware supplier with little consumer brand; F1 hospitality has modest value.
changed: Listed via merger with Landcadia Holdings III in 2021

name: El Corte Inglés
desc: Spain's largest department store group, with stores, supermarkets, travel and online retail across Spain and Portugal.
markets: Stores in Spain and Portugal plus online sales.
rationale: Major Spanish retailer with premium brands; the Madrid Grand Prix from 2026 could support hospitality and retail activation.

name: PetSafe Brands
desc: Makes pet products including electronic fences, training collars, feeders and fountains sold worldwide.
markets: Sells in North America, Europe and other regions through retailers and online channels.
rationale: Pet brand with consumer reach but no clear motorsport link; F1 fit is weak.

name: Future Family
desc: Fertility financing and services company that offered personalised treatment plans and payment options to women and couples.
markets: US consumers seeking fertility treatment; current operating status is unverified.
rationale: Small fertility-financing brand with unverified status and little link to the F1 audience.

name: Delvaux
desc: Belgian luxury leather goods house, founded in 1829, selling handbags and accessories through its own boutiques.
markets: Boutiques in Europe, Asia and elsewhere; owned by Hong Kong's Fung Group.
rationale: Luxury accessories brand targeting affluent buyers; F1 hospitality suits clients, though sponsorship is rarely used by this house.

name: DOMS Industries
desc: Indian maker of stationery and art products including pencils, pens, crayons and notebooks sold to students.
markets: Sells mainly across India through distributors and retailers; exports are a small share.
rationale: Domestic school-products brand with no motorsport link; F1 fit is weak. Sponsorship value appears limited.

name: Nice Tuan
desc: Chinese community group-buying platform, also called Xingsheng Youxuan, selling groceries and household goods.
markets: Chinese community customers only; current operating status is unverified.
rationale: Domestic group-buying business with unverified status; no F1 case. Sponsorship value appears limited.

name: Reddit
desc: Online platform of topic-based communities where users post and discuss; earns revenue from advertising and data licensing.
markets: Users in many countries; advertisers and offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.
rationale: Large engaged community including an active F1 following; tie-ins could suit advertising and brand awareness goals.

name: Perch
desc: Consumer brands aggregator that acquired and scaled third-party sellers on Amazon in categories such as home and pets.
markets: US-focused marketplace brands; current operating status is unverified.
rationale: Brand aggregator with little consumer recognition and constrained budget; F1 fit is weak.

name: Tupperware Brands
desc: Makes reusable food storage and kitchenware sold by direct sellers, brand now restructured after bankruptcy.
markets: Direct-selling network across North America, Europe, Asia and Latin America before restructuring.
rationale: Heritage kitchenware brand in restructuring with limited budget; F1 fit is weak.

name: SmileDirectClub
desc: Sold direct-to-consumer teledentistry services and clear teeth aligners; ceased operations after bankruptcy.
markets: Sold in the US, Canada, Australia and parts of Europe before closing.
rationale: Defunct aligner company; no current operations, so no F1 case. Sponsorship value appears limited.
changed: Filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2023 and wound down

name: Dunzo
desc: Hyperlocal delivery app that delivered groceries, food and parcels in Indian cities; scaled back after funding problems.
markets: Indian cities only; current operating status unverified. No verified international expansion plans.
rationale: Distressed Indian delivery business with no international plans; F1 sponsorship unrealistic. Sponsorship value appears limited.

name: JD Industrials
desc: Industrial supplies and MRO supply chain business linked to JD.com, selling tools, safety products and components to Chinese enterprises.
markets: Chinese manufacturers and enterprises as customers; no verified international operations.
rationale: Industrial B2B platform with no consumer brand; F1 hospitality is the only angle.

name: Dometic Group
desc: Makes products for mobile living such as RV and marine refrigerators, air conditioners and awnings, plus trucks and hospitality equipment.
markets: Sells across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific through OEM customers, dealers and retailers.
